Mr. Pooran Singh Rawat, learned counsel 
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for

3. By means of this writ petition, petitioner 
has sought the indulgence of this Court for 
quashing the impugned order dated 22.04.2022, 
annexure-9 to the writ petition, passed by 
respondent no.2 and further to direct the 
respondents to implement the order dated 
14.08.2018 in letter and spirit.

for and is granted six weeks’ time to file counter 
affidavit.
5. Thereafter, two weeks’ time is granted to 
the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
6. List this matter on 01.05.2024.
